description: The format of the csv of a bank statement of the positions as phrases (docs/json_structure.md 'csv format'): the header row, the columns that the import reads, the kind of each asset class of the bank and the values of each holding as templates, so that convert_csv writes the import json of the holdings of the portfolio split page without a name of a column, a kind or a phrase of its own. The words and triples behind the templates are declared like in any import json, because the import json of a csv copies them.

triples.name: zukunft.com system
triples.description: keyword for system internal triples such as the column definitions

triples.name: exchange rate
triples.description: An exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

triples.name: bond (finance)
triples.description: the finance reading of the ambiguous word 'bond': a debt security under which the issuer owes the holders the face value and the interest

triples.name: bond price
triples.description: the price of a bond in percent of its face value

triples.name: face value
triples.description: the nominal amount of a bond on which the interest is paid and which is repaid at maturity

triples.name: holding value
triples.description: the market value of one holding in CHF: the shares times the stock price, the face value times the bond price, or the cash amount times the exchange rate
the unit of the EUR/CHF exchange rate: how many Swiss francs one euro buys
the unit of the USD/CHF exchange rate: how many Swiss francs one US dollar buys
the unit of the exchange rate: CHF per unit of GBP
the unit of the exchange rate: CHF per unit of JPY
the unit of the exchange rate: CHF per unit of DKK
the unit of the exchange rate: CHF per unit of SEK

triples.name: asset class
triples.description: a group of investments with the same kind of risk and return that a bank lists together e.g. equities or bonds

triples.name: price currency
triples.description: the currency in which the price of an instrument is quoted

triples.name: market value
triples.description: the value of a position at the price of the market, converted to the reference currency

triples.name: reference currency
triples.description: the currency in which a bank statement shows the value of every position

triples.name: alternative investment
triples.description: an investment that is no stock, bond or cash e.g. a hedge fund, which a bank lists with its units and a price per unit

triples.name: alternative investment stock
triples.description: an alternative investment is held like a stock: its units are its shares and its price per unit is its stock price

triples.name: bank position
triples.description: a holding of a client as a bank lists it in a statement
